messages:
maria (PM): Kick-off: need final launch checklist for Optimize Toolkit. Customer asks: deterministic latency SLO for PLG and canary rollout + rollback playbook. Proposing acceptance criteria below — please review.

maria (PM): Acceptance (draft): 1) canary serves 1% traffic for 1 hour, 2) p95 latency per-path and p99 for single-shot paths below 120ms for short prompts (<=64 tokens), 3) end-to-end cost per 1k tokens within +10% of projected, 4) no regression in top-5 quality evals on customer prompt set, 5) tracing and request_id must be present in logs.

akesh (Eng-ML): Question: how strict on 120ms? For batching enabled, p95/p99 depend on throughput. Suggest we specify both: p95_per_path and p99_single_shot. Also call out quantized vs FP variants separately.

jules (Eng-Platform): Agree with canary %/duration. Add circuit-breaker: if error rate > 0.5% or latency increase >50% vs baseline, auto-roll to stable. Also require metric tags: model_variant, canary_id, region.

sam (SRE): Add alerting: pager if canary fails for 3 consecutive minutes. Also require tracing tags for request_id and model_variant, and a synthetic canary probe every 30s.

tina (QA): Edge cases to cover: cold-start for quantized variants, cache warm-up behavior, truncated prompt handling, and CPU fallback. Need test harness: load test with 10k short prompts and 500 long prompts including KV-cache disabled runs.

lee (Customer Success): Customer ask: deterministic fallback to full-precision (FP32) if quality drops below threshold. They want documented rollback steps and a customer-facing incident playbook and notification template.

maria (PM): Draft rollback Playbook snippet:
```
1) Pause canary routing (Console -> Rollouts -> Pause).
2) Re-route 100% to stable model variant.
3) Trigger automated rebaseline + eval job.
4) Notify customers with template and open incident with RCA tag.
```

akesh (Eng-ML): Also include automated eval job that runs 1k prompts from customer baseline and compares semantic similarity + token logprob. Threshold: quality drop >3% semantic-similarity -> rollback. For quantized variants include parity test vs FP within 2-3% metric band.

jules (Eng-Platform): Sample canary config we can add to PRD:
```
canary:
  percent: 1
  duration_minutes: 60
  rollback_on:
    - error_rate_pct: 0.5
    - p99_latency_increase_pct: 50
    - semantic_delta_pct: 3
    - cost_increase_pct: 10
```

tina (QA): Acceptance tests to add to PRD: replay with KV-cache disabled, verify prefix-cache compatibility under batching, and quantized inference parity within 2% token-level logprob difference. Also automate a smoke test for compositional prompts.

maria (PM): OK can we get signoff from eng + QA by EOD tomorrow? @akesh @jules @tina please ack or propose edits. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: canary_autoscheduler: scheduled canary window at 2259950000 for canary_id: optkit-canary-2025-09.

maria (PM): Thanks — I'll fold these into the PRD section "Canary & Rollback" and attach the example config + test checklist.
